env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^flat: \{"title":"t","n":\{"name":"n"\},"s":"shout"\}$'
stdout '^self: json: unsupported value: encountered a cycle via \*cycle\.Node$'
stdout '^root: json: unsupported value: encountered a cycle via \*main\.Root$'
stdout '^honour: \{"xs":\["shout"\]\}$'
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/json/walk.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/json/walkfields.go
exists out/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v0.0.0/cycle/cycle.go
exec grep '_logos_json "github.com/gosuda/loGos/rt/json"' out/main.go

exec grep -rhnE '_logos_[A-Za-z0-9_]+ "github\.com/gosuda/loGos/[^"]*"' out --include=*.go
cp stdout $WORK/eject-support-imports-json.txt
! exec grep -vE '_logos_(rt|json) "github\.com/gosuda/loGos/rt(/json)?"' $WORK/eject-support-imports-json.txt

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cd ..

cd out
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/jsoncycle

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep v0.0.0 => ../dep

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/dep/cycle"
)

// Root holds a foreign Node by value for acyclic cross-package use and
// nests its own Kids for a same-package cycle: helpers and the Gen
// table live in this package and share this root's Walk.
type Root struct {
	Title string     `json:"title"`
	N     cycle.Node `json:"n"`
	S     cycle.Shout `json:"s"`
	Kids  []any      `json:"kids,omitempty"`
}

func printErr(label string, err error) {
	if err == nil {
		fmt.Println(label, "no error")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(label, err.Error())
}

func main() {
	r := Root{Title: "t", N: cycle.Node{Name: "n"}, S: cycle.Shout{V: 1}}
	buf, err := r.MarshalJSON()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("flat error:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("flat:", string(buf))

	n := &cycle.Node{Name: "c"}
	n.Next = n
	_, err = n.MarshalJSON()
	printErr("self:", err)

	rr := &Root{Title: "x"}
	rr.Kids = []any{rr}
	_, err = rr.MarshalJSON()
	printErr("root:", err)

	h := struct {
		Xs []any `json:"xs"`
	}{Xs: []any{cycle.Shout{V: 2}}}
	buf, err = json.Marshal(h)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("honour error:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("honour:", string(buf))
}

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27

-- dep/cycle/cycle.lgo --
package cycle

// Node is a generated-side struct in its own package: its helpers and
// table live here and share the caller's Walk. Foreign importers
// honour it through a fresh encoding.
type Node struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	Next *Node  `json:"next,omitempty"`
	Kids []any  `json:"kids,omitempty"`
}

// Shout keeps a genuine user override: generated callers must honour
// it through a fresh encoding, never walk it.
type Shout struct {
	V int `json:"v"`
}

func (Shout) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte(`"shout"`), nil
}
